plugin.name: UIExtensions Menu
plugin.description: Adds a menu for manually customizing armor variants for yourself or NPCs. Requires UIExtensions and MCM Helper.

plugin.name: Hidden Equipment
plugin.description: Contains invisible armor addons for helmets, circlets, backpacks, and cloaks. This addon is not usable by itself and is recommended to be used alongside the UIExtensions Menu addon.

plugin.name: Disabled
plugin.description: Leaves DAVE's skill leveling hook disabled. Choose this if you use a skill overhaul such as Static Skill Leveling, or if you do not need armor skill experience to follow the source armor type after DAVE replaces an armor's visuals.

plugin.name: Enabled
plugin.description: Enables DAVE's skill leveling hook. This makes heavy and light armor skill experience use the original worn armor type instead of the armor type from the DAVE-resolved visual replacement. This is unnecessary if you use a mod like Static Skill Leveling.
